summary: Recalibrated context-gate INJECT side off the first positive (held-out task→transcript win, note-mq7kyiir6sx). Reproduced real semantic scores: positive scored top1 cosine 0.548, top2 0.531 (margin 0.017) — OLD rule (cos≥0.55 AND margin≥0.12) abstained & MISSED the win. Confirmed task's key insight empirically: MiniLM packs topical orchestrator notes into a tight 0.50–0.55 band, so neither lowering cosine nor margin separates the positive from topical noise. The separator is a NEW external-gap signal = fraction of the top note's content tokens that recur in the task (positive 0.34 vs every topical negative ≤0.17). Also fixed the note-TYPE classifier: it had MISclassified the positive as 'principle' (the "always include…" phrasing) — added empirical markers (silently / is wrong / recovered only / ~N%) so a measured silent failure reads as empirical. NEW RULE: INJECT iff top1≥0.50 AND top note empirical AND (margin≥0.12 OR external-gap≥0.25). CONFUSION MATRIX (scoped: 1 positive + 5 plain negatives): TP=1 FN=0 FP=0 TN=5 → scoped REGRET=0; v1–v7 regret unchanged at 0 (690,510 tok-eq overhead still avoided). HONEST CAVEAT (PROVISIONAL, n=1): same-micro-domain controls graph-dependent & wincase-c retrieve the SAME note and are textually NEARER to it than the positive itself (inject 2/2) — no monotone threshold on {cos,margin,gap} separates a held-out win from its self-solvable twins, because held-out-ness is structural/external to the note↔task gate. Not counted in regret (note post-dates them → temporal). Thresholds to be firmed up by task #9's second positive. Updated lib/context-gate.js (+externalGap/contentTokens, new DEFAULTS cos0.50/gap0.25), bench/context-gate-eval.js (+heldoutConfusion + regenerated .md), test/context-gate.test.js (21/21 pass). Did NOT restart daemon.
